products.name: The Original Tee
products.description: Our signature tee made from 100% organic combed cotton. Pre-shrunk, breathable, and absurdly soft — it only gets better with every wash.

products.name: The All-Day Hoodie
products.description: A heavyweight fleece hoodie with a brushed interior, kangaroo pocket and ribbed cuffs. Warm enough for winter evenings, light enough for all day.

products.name: The Relaxed Shirt
products.description: An easy, relaxed-fit button-up in a breathable cotton weave. Dress it up with chinos or wear it open over a tee — it works either way.

products.name: The Motion Jogger
products.description: Four-way stretch joggers with a drawstring waist, tapered leg and deep side pockets. Made for morning runs and lazy Sundays alike.

products.name: The CloudSoft Tee
products.description: A relaxed-fit women’s tee in our softest cotton jersey, with a flattering drape and drop shoulders. The one you’ll reach for every single week.

products.name: The Breezy Dress
products.description: A flowy midi dress with short sleeves and side pockets (yes, real pockets). Light, airy, and endlessly wearable from brunch to sunset.

products.name: The Cozy Knit Sweater
products.description: A chunky-knit sweater with a slightly oversized fit and ribbed hem. Like wearing a warm hug, but make it fashion.

products.name: The Classic Denim Jacket
products.description: A timeless light-wash denim jacket with metal buttons and two chest pockets. The layer that finishes every outfit, season after season.
